demoNotice: Project owner confirms this workflow uses LAHSA Form 1083. This local app prepares a draft; it does not submit to HMIS.

sourceConfirmation.notes: The project owner confirmed that LAHSA Habitability Standards Inspection Form 1083 is the form used and submitted in this workflow. These eleven area labels follow the project owner's Form 1083 model. The app prepares a local draft and has no HMIS submission connection; exact form wording and provider acceptance of this app's export are not asserted.

items.label: Structure and materials
items.captureGuidance: Photograph the relevant structure or building materials in context. Keep the area visible and exclude people, documents, and identifying details.

manualChecks.instruction: Inspect whether the building feels safe and structurally sound, as if it is not going to fall down. Record what you observed and any area you could not assess; a photo alone cannot establish structural condition.

items.label: Access
items.captureGuidance: Photograph the entry and any other available exit route in context. Exclude people and identifying details.

manualChecks.instruction: Check that residents can access the housing without entering another person's private property and that the structure provides a usable fire-escape option other than the front door. A photo cannot establish that a route is usable.

items.label: Space and security
items.captureGuidance: Photograph the available sleeping space and relevant door hardware without showing people or personal belongings.

manualChecks.instruction: Confirm adequate space and security for each resident and their belongings, an acceptable place to sleep, and doors that lock. Record any limitation; a photo cannot confirm that a lock works.

items.label: Interior air quality / ventilation
items.captureGuidance: Photograph the relevant window, fan, or ventilation fixture in place. Exclude people and identifying details.

manualChecks.instruction: Check that every room or space has natural or mechanical ventilation. Operate the available fan or air conditioning to confirm it works; a photo alone cannot establish airflow.

items.label: Water supply
items.captureGuidance: Photograph the relevant faucet, basin, or water fixture in context. Exclude people and identifying details.

manualChecks.instruction: Check that the supply is free from contamination. Operate all faucets and confirm working, hot, clear water; a photo cannot establish flow, clarity, or temperature.

items.label: Sanitary facilities
items.captureGuidance: Photograph relevant sanitary facilities without including people, personal items, or identifying details.

manualChecks.instruction: Check that sanitary facilities are sufficient, in proper operating condition, usable in privacy, and adequate for personal cleanliness. Include shared-space facilities; a photo cannot establish function or privacy.

items.label: Thermal environment
items.captureGuidance: Photograph the relevant heating or cooling equipment in place. Exclude people and identifying details.

manualChecks.instruction: Check that adequate heating or cooling facilities are in proper operating condition and operate the available equipment to confirm it works. A photo cannot establish operation.

items.label: Lighting and electricity
items.captureGuidance: Photograph relevant lighting and outlets in context. Do not touch damaged equipment; exclude people and identifying details.

manualChecks.instruction: Check that natural or artificial light supports normal indoor activities and health and safety, and that enough safe outlets are available for essential appliances. Do not test damaged equipment; a photo cannot confirm operation or safety.

items.label: Food preparation and refuse disposal
items.captureGuidance: Photograph relevant food-preparation and refuse-disposal areas in context. Exclude people and identifying details.

manualChecks.instruction: Check that food-preparation areas have suitable space and equipment to store, prepare, and serve food sanitarily. Inspect shared space and refuse disposal; a photo cannot establish usability.

items.label: Sanitary condition
items.captureGuidance: Photograph the relevant area as found. Avoid people, documents, and personal details.

manualChecks.instruction: Assess whether the housing and its equipment are maintained in sanitary condition. Record areas you could not assess; a photo cannot establish the condition of the whole unit.

items.label: Fire safety
items.captureGuidance: Capture smoke and carbon monoxide detectors on each occupied unit level and smoke detectors in accessible public or common areas. Do not remove or handle equipment for the photo.

manualChecks.instruction: Form 1083 section 11: check 11a working smoke/CO detectors on each occupied unit level and bedroom-adjacent hallway placement if practicable, plus any hearing-impaired alarm provision; check 11b at least one smoke detector in every public/common area. No health details; mark unknown if unassessed.
